description: This source file defines the internal class MembershipTableCleanupAgent, responsible for periodically cleaning up defunct entries in the membership table within the Orleans runtime. It manages timers, handles cleanup logic, and participates in lifecycle and health check interfaces.

classes.name: MembershipTableCleanupAgent
classes.description: Handles scheduled cleanup of defunct silo entries from the membership table, integrating with silo lifecycle and health checks.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSilos
methods.description: Performs the main cleanup loop, periodically invoking the membership table cleanup based on configuration.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the agent to the silo lifecycle stages, starting and stopping cleanup tasks.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Starts the cleanup task when silo lifecycle reaches Active stage.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops cleanup activities and disposes resources when silo lifecycle stops.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Implements health check interface to report the status of the cleanup timer.
